data.explanation: This is a first reminder (1. Mahnung) from an online clothing retailer for an unpaid order. They say the original invoice of €89.90 plus a €2.50 late fee is now due, totaling €92.40, by the deadline shown. Check whether you already paid the original invoice — if so, you can treat this letter as resolved per their own note. Otherwise, transfer the amount to the IBAN given, quoting your customer number, by the deadline. If ignored, further reminders or fees, and eventually a formal collection/court process, could follow, though none is mentioned yet in this letter.
